bugs.name: Double-charged slippage
bugs.effect: Every trade paid slippage twice; fill price already included it.

bugs.name: Frozen benchmark
bugs.effect: An underfunded basket had every order correctly rejected by the cost floor, so buy-and-hold bought nothing and reported +0.00% for six straight years.

bugs.name: Silent leverage
bugs.effect: Same-day signals each sized against the same cash figure, reaching 175% exposure in a cash long-only account.

bugs.name: Missed corporate actions
bugs.effect: NSE reports prev_close unadjusted for some bonuses; HDFCBANK's 1:1 left a phantom -51% crash in the data.

bugs.name: Lost trading days
bugs.effect: A hardcoded date format and a missing network retry each silently deleted a whole trading day.
